name: Franz Wagner
title: The Euro step
build_note: Listed 6-10, 220 lb (RealGM, Basketball-Reference); reported 7-0 wingspan (CraftedNBA). No approved look yet: drawn as the team-colour silhouette.
steps: Picks it up high, at full speed.
A long stride to one side. The help bites.
Back across, around him, soft floater.
aria: Animated illustration of Franz Wagner's Euro step: he drives at full speed, gathers the ball high with both hands, takes one long stride to one side so the help defender slides over, then a second long stride back across and around him, and finishes with a soft one-hand floater. Footprints and a line on the floor show the zig-zag of the two strides. An original drawing, not traced from footage, not to scale.
